SELECT n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS table,a.attname AS column,
format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS type,col_description(c.oid,a.attnum) AS description
FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace
WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND c.relkind IN ('r','v','m','p','f') AND n.nspname IN ('csmar','wind') ORDER BY 1,2,a.attnum
